source_spans: was stopped at a red light
source_sentences: A Cruise autonomous vehicle ("Cruise AV"), operating in driverless autonomous mode, was stopped at a red light on northbound Van Ness Avenue at the intersection with Sacramento Street.
At the same time, a Toyota Sedan on westbound Sacramento Street began was making an unprotected right turn on a red light onto northbound Van Ness Avenue behind the Cruise AV.
